messages:
maya: Heads-up — canary small-batch p95 spiked after the CUDA 13.0.1 driver roll earlier today. From ~42ms -> ~82ms on a100-small. Holding rollout. :warning:

sahil: Saw the same on the latency dashboard. Is it just generation routes or everything?

maya: Gen small-batch (seq=32, batch=1) worst. Embeddings/large-batch mostly unchanged. KV cache path looks slower on traces.

ben: I started profiling on the canary node. nsys traces show a different matmul algo and extra H2D memcpy around prefetch.

ben: Snippet from nsys summary:
```
nsys: cublasLtMatmul algo=23 time=9.8ms  (prev stable algo=5 time=4.0ms)
memcpy H2D 1.2ms -> 3.9ms during kv-prefetch stage
```

rory: That algo flip smells like a cuBLAS heuristic change in 13.0.1. We've seen minor-driver heuristic flips before.

sahil: Can we force the kernel selection back for now (env override or Triton autotune table pin)?

ben: Tested forcing cuBLAS algo=5 via env override on canary (quick smoke). p95 returned to ~43ms. Definitive signal it's algo selection + memcpy interplay.

maya: Great repro. We need a mitigation quickly: pin algo or disable the problematic heuristic while we engage NVIDIA. Ben, can you bisect the driver image and confirm? Open a perf issue.

ben: Starting bisect over driver image tags and our runtime bundle now. Also re-running the nightly perf job to attach artifacts.

ci-bot: nightly-perf-smallbatch job failed on canary: https://ci/reports/12345 — p95=82ms (threshold 55ms). Tagging @perf-team.

perf-bot: Created perf issue #987: "small-batch p95 regression after driver 13.0.1" with baseline diffs and nsys artifacts.

ben: Bisect progress: local repro shows reverting driver 13.0.1 -> 13.0.0 restores previous alg selection and latency. Marking driver as likely culprit.

maya: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) Hold further driver rollouts 2) Add runtime override to prefer previously-good cuBLAS alg per model 3) Engage NVIDIA to understand heuristic change.

sahil: I'll open a runtime PR to add a model-scoped cuBLAS-algo override and a unit perf test to catch this class of regression.

rory: Also recommend adding a KV-prefetch memcpy aggregation guard — current prefetch issues issue 4x small H2D transfers; combining reduces host->device overhead and reduces sensitivity to small memcpy regressions.

ben: I'll add a microbench for aggregated memcpy vs multiple small ones and include it in the PR.

maya: Filing incident (rollout-blocker) and pausing any canary promotions. Please keep updates in this thread.

maya: Thanks — keep logs/artifacts on the perf issue. :white_check_mark:
